```{r setup, include = FALSE}
options(Encoding = "UTF-8")
library(gt)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

style_gt <- function(gt_tbl) {
  n_rows <- nrow(gt_tbl$`_data`)
  
  gt_tbl %>% 
    tab_options(table.font.size = px(12)) %>%
    tab_style(
      style = cell_borders(sides = "top", weight = px(1.5)),
      locations = cells_column_labels()
    ) %>%
    tab_style(
      style = cell_borders(sides = "bottom", weight = px(1.5)),
      locations = cells_column_labels()
    ) %>%
    tab_style(
      style = cell_borders(sides = "top", weight = px(1.5)),
      locations = cells_body(rows = seq_len(n_rows) == 1)
    ) %>%
    tab_style(
      style = cell_borders(sides = "bottom", weight = px(1.5)),
      locations = cells_body(rows = seq_len(n_rows) == n_rows)
    ) %>%
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(align = "left"),
      locations = cells_column_labels()
    )
}
```

## Summary

```{r inputs, echo = FALSE}
inputs <- params$input
inputs <- inputs[!names(inputs) == "sidebarItemExpanded"]

mat <- tribble(
  ~'Number of risks',                                  ~'ClinO A', ~'ClinO B', ~'ClinO C',
  'Less than 6 medium risks, no high risks',           'low',      'low',      'medium',
  '6 to 12 medium risks or 1 high risk',               'low',      'medium',   'high',
  'More than 12 medium risks, more than 1 high risk',  'medium',   'high',     'high'
)

# mat is a tibble — [row, col] returns a 1x1 tibble. Extract the scalar.
txt <- mat[[paste("ClinO", params$input$clino_cat)]][params$overall$row]
```

Swiss risk category: `r inputs$clino_cat`

Based on the assumptions fed into the RBM score calculator, the study risk is `r txt` and we thus recommend applying the monitoring strategy for **`r txt`-risk trials**.

`#linebreak() `{=typst}
The following risks are rated as high in this trial:

```{r high-risk, echo = FALSE}
# Prepare data for table generation
tmp <- as.data.frame(inputs) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), as.character)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), 
               names_to = c("i", "j"), 
               names_pattern = "(.*)_(imp|occ|det|tx|appl|note)$") %>%
  filter(!is.na(i)) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = "i", names_from = "j", values_from = "value") %>%
  mutate(imp = factor(imp, c("Low", "Moderate", "High")),
         occ = factor(occ, c("Rare", "Occasional", "Frequent")),
         det = factor(det, c("Simple", "Moderate", "Difficult")),
         across(c("imp", "occ", "appl", "det"), as.numeric),
         across(c("imp", "occ", "det"), ~ case_when(appl == 0 ~ 0,
                                                  TRUE ~ .)),
         score = imp*occ*det,
         appl = case_when(grepl("other", .data$i) ~ 1,
                          TRUE ~ appl)) %>% 
  filter(grepl(paste0("other(", paste0(params$ids, collapse = "|"), ")"), .data$i) | !grepl("other", .data$i)) 
  
#Rename labels and incorporate information from 'Other Risks'
tmp2 <- as.data.frame(params$texttab) %>%
  full_join(tmp, by = c("ref" = "i")) %>%     
  mutate(Impact = imp,
         Occurance = occ,
         Detectability = det,
         Score = score,
         Category = category,
         Description = note
         ) %>%
  mutate(Category = case_when(!is.na(Category) ~ Category,
                              is.na(Category) ~ "VII. Other Risks"))

  if("tx" %in% names(tmp)) tmp2 <- tmp2 %>% 
  mutate(Risk = case_when(!is.na(Risk) ~ Risk,
                          is.na(Risk) ~ tx),
         Description = case_when(!is.na(Description) ~ Description,
                             is.na(Description) ~ ""))


tmp2 %>% 
  filter(Score > 9) %>% 
  select(Category, Risk, Description) %>% 
  gt() %>% 
  style_gt() %>%
  cols_width(
  Category ~ pct(20),
  Risk ~ pct(26),
  Description ~ pct(54)
) %>%
tab_options(table.width = pct(100))
```

### All risks
```{r risk-tabs-clean, echo = FALSE}

tmp2 %>%
  mutate(Note = Description) %>%
  select(Category, Risk, Note, Impact, Occurance, Detectability, Score) %>%
  gt() %>% 
  style_gt() %>%
  tab_options(table.font.size = px(9)) %>%
  cols_width(Category ~ pct(10), Risk ~ pct(18), Note ~ pct(45)) %>%
  tab_options(table.width = pct(100))%>%
  sub_missing(columns = c(Impact, Occurance, Detectability, Score),
    missing_text = "0") %>%
  sub_missing(columns = Note, rows = everything(), missing_text = "")
```
